comment: Extracts data from the MP3 container format.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING
variables.comment:
* Flag to force enable seeking using a constant bitrate assumption in cases where seeking would * otherwise not be possible. * *

This flag is ignored if {@link #FLAG_ENABLE_INDEX_SEEKING} is set.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING_ALWAYS
variables.comment:
* Like {@link #FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING}, except that seeking is also enabled in * cases where the content length (and hence the duration of the media) is unknown. Application * code should ensure that requested seek positions are valid when using this flag, or be ready to * handle playback failures reported through {@link Player.Listener#onPlayerError} with {@link * PlaybackException#errorCode} set to {@link * PlaybackException#ERROR_CODE_IO_READ_POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE}. * *

If this flag is set, then the behavior enabled by {@link * #FLAG_ENABLE_CONSTANT_BITRATE_SEEKING} is implicitly enabled. * *

This flag is ignored if {@link #FLAG_ENABLE_INDEX_SEEKING} is set.

variables.name: FLAG_ENABLE_INDEX_SEEKING
variables.comment:
* Flag to force index seeking, in which a time-to-byte mapping is built as the file is read. * *

This seeker may require to scan a significant portion of the file to compute a seek point. * Therefore, it should only be used if one of the following is true: * *

    *
  • The file is small. *
  • The bitrate is variable (or it's unknown whether it's variable) and the file does not * provide precise enough seeking metadata. *

variables.name: FLAG_DISABLE_ID3_METADATA
variables.comment:
* Flag to disable parsing of ID3 metadata. Can be set to save memory if ID3 metadata is not
   * required.

variables.name: REQUIRED_ID3_FRAME_PREDICATE
variables.comment: Predicate that matches ID3 frames containing only required gapless/seeking metadata.

variables.name: MAX_SYNC_BYTES
variables.comment: The maximum number of bytes to search when synchronizing, before giving up.

variables.name: MAX_SNIFF_BYTES
variables.comment: * The maximum number of bytes to peek when sniffing, excluding the ID3 header, before giving up.

variables.name: SCRATCH_LENGTH
variables.comment: Maximum length of data read into {@link #scratch}.

variables.name: MPEG_AUDIO_HEADER_MASK
variables.comment: Mask that includes the audio header values that must match between frames.

methods.comment:
* Consumes the next frame from the {@code input} if it contains VBRI or Xing seeking metadata,
   * returning a {@link Seeker} if the metadata was present and valid, or {@code null} otherwise.
   * After this method returns, the input position is the start of the first frame of audio.
   *
   * @param input The {@link ExtractorInput} from which to read.
   * @return A {@link Seeker} if seeking metadata was present and valid, or {@code null} otherwise.
   * @throws IOException Thrown if there was an error reading from the stream. Not expected if the
   *     next two frames were already peeked during synchronization.
